Title: Prohibits the termination of coverage for rehabilitation services solely because of a failure to demonstrate measurable improvement in the applicable condition
Summary: Provides that a utilization review agent shall not issue an adverse determination denying, reducing, or terminating coverage for medically necessary skilled rehabilitation services solely because the insured or enrollee has failed to demonstrate measurable improvement in the insured's or enrollee's condition.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the insurance law, in relation to prohibiting the termination of coverage for rehabilitation services solely because of a failure to demonstrate measurable improvement in the applicable condition
